lines.text: They told you it was just a game.
It is not.
Four legends. One board. And one golden prize...
the World Cup itself.
Whoever rules this board lifts it. The rest go home with nothing.
And the board has only one law.
Score a goal, and you own what you touch.
Create one for a teammate, and you move.
But do nothing... and the board locks you away. In jail.
Round one is over. And the board has already crowned its first king.
Lionel Messi. Three goals against Algeria. A perfect hat-trick.
He did not celebrate. He simply... collected.
A full set. The richest corner on the board. The quiet king leads.
Kylian Mbappe ran like the board was on fire.
Two goals against Senegal. And a golden card no one saw coming.
The greatest scorer France has ever produced. Fifty-eight.
Erling Haaland did not run. He built.
Two goals against Iraq. Two houses. A wall rising in the north.
And then... there was the king they all came to dethrone.
Cristiano Ronaldo. The greatest of his age.
One game. No goal. No assist. A single, silent draw.
And the board does not care about your name.
The bars came down... on the legend himself.
They counted him out before. The world remembers how that ended.
Behind the bars, he is not broken. He is waiting.
So this is the board, after round one.
Messi rules. Mbappe and Haaland climb. And the greatest of them all sits in a cell.
But the cup is not won in a single round.
The dice are rising again.
And a cornered legend, with nothing left to lose, is the most dangerous player on the board.
One question remains. Who is dealing this game... and what does he want?
Round two holds the answer.
Now... the dice are yours.
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three legends, and collect them all.
Climb the board. Chase the cup. Free to play, for glory alone.
The cell is open. Who escapes first? You decide.
